tools.name: list_my_campaigns
tools.description: Lists the campaigns the signed-in organiser chose to share with this assistant: public code, name, status and draw date.

tools.name: get_campaign_overview
tools.description: Returns the overview of one shared campaign by its public code: name, status, start and draw dates, ticket price, number of prizes, modules turned on, and the links to its public page and to its console.

tools.name: get_campaign_figures
tools.description: Returns the aggregated sales figures of one shared campaign: tickets sold, amount collected, and a daily series over the requested number of days. The figures are totals only, with no detail per sale or per buyer.

tools.name: get_todo
tools.description: Returns the to-do list of one shared campaign: each item with its phase, whether it blocks the campaign or is recommended, its label, and the console link where it is done.

tools.name: get_launch_readiness
tools.description: Returns whether one shared campaign can be launched, the items still missing with their console links, and the status code of its authorisation.

tools.name: get_share_kit
tools.description: Returns the sharing kit of one shared campaign: its short link and its tracked links, with their sale counts when available.

tools.name: prepare_campaign_draft

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_authority, get_campaign_overview, get_campaign_figures · Private data: get_legal_frame · Public sink: list_my_campaigns, get_share_kit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_authority, get_campaign_overview, get_campaign_figures · Private data: get_legal_frame · Public sink: list_my_campaigns, get_share_kit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
